newsitem.title: UK: Daily Mail sees Channel One loss declining.
newsitem.headline: Daily Mail sees Channel One loss declining.

text.p: The Daily Mail and General Trust Plc (DMGT) said on Friday losses in the current year at its Channel One cable television subsidiary would be similar to those of last year but it saw improvement further out.

As a result of a lower cost base and more targeted programming, DMGT expects losses at Channel One will fall "significantly" next year. DMGT said it was cutting 64 jobs at Channel One in order to to "significantly" reduce its cost base.
"Break-even will be achieved earlier and well within the original project investment budget," said the company in a statement.
The British publishing and media group did not unveil the scale of losses at Channel One when it released first-half results on June 12, but the unit has lost 10 million stg in past years.
